chapter: Clubs, publishers, unions and life in Denver
title: Playing a grand piano for a night at the American Legion
summary: He plays only organ now, but played a grand piano at an upstairs Legion party and enjoyed the two-beat sound with his drummer.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Uh-huh. I lost my question because unfortunately.
(unintelligible). Is it about the organ or about the piano?
Do you play piano also on your jobs or it's strictly organ?

Strictly I play the organ, with the exception of last Saturday night. They had a birthday upstairs in the American Legion club. (unintelligible). I don't know if it was a birthday or anniversary, but they have a ballroom type place upstairs, and there was no way I was going to disassemble that organ down in the small club and take it up there, so they have had a piano -- an excellent piano, grand, upstairs, and (unintelligible). I went up and tried it. Since it was only for one night and what have you, (unintelligible) I just decided to play piano (unintelligible). and it worked out real well and I liked it.
Do you miss playing the piano?

Well, the type of work we're doing, no, because I've begun to like the sound it gives the combo, and I've learned to play some (unintelligible) choruses with the little licks and things in there which I know would be lost on the piano -- so actually, (unintelligible), but I did enjoy that last Saturday night because when I come home, if I get lonesome or one of these things, I just play here, -- we hovered together and it was a big place, we got together real close like some chickens, you know, and we had ample mikes. I didn't play too many solos, and I

sang my vocalist quite a bit that night. I leaned more or less toward the bass. It was an excellent piano, and it was in tune, and it sounded good. And I has my drummer his his bass drum as something that --

Yeah, get that (unintelligible) beat going. We that night sounded more or less like a two beat band you know? But -- and he got a kick out of it, you know, because usually when he doesn't use you play the organ on there, his pedal, his bass pedal as often as he had to isn't (unintelligible) that night, you know.
So it was a little change. I liked it.
